Connection diagnostics

A connection is checked only after its Terms are accepted: list_licenses, then a readability check, because list_licenses is account-level and succeeds even when the OAuth application isn't authorised for the accounts that own those licences. A pasted connector id can be remembered but cannot be called until this artifact is rebuilt declaring it — connecting a connector and authorising its tools for an artifact are two separate steps.

Terms and Conditions

Accept these Terms before the Matrix contacts the Revizto MCP Server on the connection you have selected.

The Revizto Project Intelligence Matrix is provided under the Revizto Custom Licence (LICENSE.md). It is provided as is, with no warranty and no service level, and nothing it shows is a commitment about any other Revizto product. These Terms add to that licence; where the two differ, the licence governs.

What it reads

The Matrix reads from your Revizto environment through the Revizto MCP Server, using the connection you select. It reads your account list, licences, projects, clash tests, clash groups, clashes and stamp templates, and only when you ask it to. Each figure is stamped with the time it was read.

What it keeps on this device

Figures read from Revizto are not kept between sessions. This browser does keep, in its local storage for this page: the licence and project you last chose on each connection (their Revizto identifiers), the regions and the number of licences found when a connection was last checked, your acceptance of these Terms on each connection — the full name you signed with, the time, and your browser's user-agent string — and the governance documents you author here. None of it is sent anywhere. To remove it, clear this page's site data in your browser's settings; saved documents can also be pruned one at a time from the Storage panel on the Clash Test Editor.

What it cannot do

It uses read-only tools. It cannot create, modify or delete anything in Revizto — no issues, no clash tests, no project settings. Governance you author here is held on this device. A clash-test file you export is written to your computer, and reaches Revizto only if you import it yourself.

Where your data goes

Data read from Revizto stays in this browser session and in the files you save. The Matrix has no server of its own and sends your project data to no third party.

Accuracy

Figures are reported as the Revizto API returns them. Where a value cannot be read, the Matrix reports not gradeable rather than inferring a verdict. Sampled or truncated reads are labelled as such. The Matrix is not a system of record: check any decision that matters against Revizto itself.

One acceptance for each connection

Each Revizto MCP server is a separate connection to a separate environment. Accepting these Terms covers the connection you have selected, and records the full name you sign with on this device. Choosing a different server asks again, because it is a different environment and possibly a different organisation account.
